_comment: Website-local (not a desktop vector): sync-v2.md §14 phase 8's landmine, INV-1. A dataset scope's live rows may be written DIRECTLY by this host only while the scope's journal_role is 'authority'. The three dormant row editors (dictation cues, book sentences, book audio) are the only website writers of a live data.sqlite3 outside the journal/authority route and the mirror card inbox, and `journal_role` defaults to 'mirror' — so before this gate the sole thing between an owner's cue/book edit and a corrupted hub authority was a UI flag (EDIT_ENABLED=false). Default-deny is the point: anything that is not exactly 'authority' is refused, including the empty string and any value no code has ever written. PURE — no fs, no DB, no socket; the source-shape half reads the three action files because a 'use server' action cannot be imported here.

catalog.why: gateDatasetRead must hand the role to the live-row gates (its row is a cast, so this is the only pin that catches the column dropping out of the shared select)
the catalog type must carry the role the gates read

serialize_must_not_leak: INV-17: the catalog wire JSON is an EXPLICIT field list, which is what keeps widening the shared select from adding journal_role to any response. If serializeDataset ever becomes a spread, this must be re-reviewed as a wire change, not re-passed.

no_wire_leak.reason: the catalog wire shape must not gain an internal sync field (INV-17)

expect_sites_comment: expect_sites is a deliberate second list of the same three sites: dropping one from `sites` alone goes red, so a gate cannot be quietly un-pinned.
